Rippling._comment: Bangalore dinner client. Needs these DB slot_counts on Counter 1: veg_dry 2 (already), bread 2, nonveg_main 2, and categories + curd (curd_side stays as the raita slot). See the SQL note delivered with this file.
Rippling._disable_comment: curd_raita_logic picks curd-or-raita for the single curd_side slot; Rippling has two slots now (curd = curd only, curd_side = raita only). nonveg_main_daily_pair wants a dry + a chicken gravy whenever 2+ non-veg slots exist; Rippling's second dish is Wednesday-only and is chicken + egg, which rippling_wed_chicken_and_egg below states instead.

rules._comment: The second non-veg dish exists on Wednesday only; every other day serves one non-veg main and __2 stays blank.
rules.name: rippling_second_nonveg_wed_only

rules._comment: Wednesday: one chicken and one egg dish (components are >=, and two cells make that exactly one each).
rules.name: rippling_wed_chicken_and_egg

rules._comment: curd_side is the RAITA slot: a one-slot composition IS 'this slot must be a raita' (repo_map note 20). The plain-curd station is the separate `curd` slot, whose pool is already plain curd only.
rules.name: rippling_raita_only

rules._comment: Bread 1 is pinned to plain chapati every day below, so it is a staple: exempt from unique_items and the 20-day cooldown, else week 2 finds it in history and goes INFEASIBLE (same as DXC).
rules.name: rippling_plain_chapati_repeatable

constant_items._comment: bread__1 = plain chapati daily; bread__2 is solved from the pool. Pinning one expansion leaves the other free, the same shape as Plan View's nonveg_main__2.
